steps.text:
**K8SNode** schema (primary key = `name`)

- **name** (string) – unique node name
- **status** (string) – e.g. Ready, NotReady
- **roles** (string) – role(s) assigned to the node
- **age** (string) – how long the node has been running
- **version** (string) – Kubernetes version on the node
- **internalIp** (string) – internal IP address
- **osImage** (string) – OS image
- **kernelVersion** (string) – kernel version
- **containerRuntime** (string) – container runtime in use
- **clusterName** (string) – the K8SCluster this node belongs to
